    The right-hand side of the spread formula

    spreadRHS.Rd

    The spread climate variable(s), youngAge, then the other covariates (fuel, non-forest), joined with " + "; then, with spreadInteractions = "climate:fuel", one interaction term (climate:fuel) for each climate variable and each fuel covariate (fireSenseUtils::spreadFuelCols(): not youngAge, nfLCC_* or treedWetland), climate first, after all the main effects. Without interactions the string is what it always was, so the cache keys that hold it do not move.

    spreadRHS(
  spreadCovariates,
  spreadVars,
  vegColsForRHS,
  spreadInteractions = character()
)

    Arguments

    spreadCovariates

    the module's spreadCovariates: "none" gives character(), the null model.

    spreadVars

    character; the spread climate variable(s).

    vegColsForRHS

    character; the other covariates (not youngAge or the climate variables).

    spreadInteractions

    the module's spreadInteractions; NULL or character(0) for none.

    Value

    a character string, or character() for the null model.
